enchantments.tooltip: Attack Bonus +4: Provides a +4 competence bonus to your attack rolls.
Exceptional Seeker +4: Provides a +4 Insight bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +4 Insight bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Mythic Wrist Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
